faq_heading: Homes near Walnut Grove Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Walnut Grove Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Walnut Grove Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Walnut Grove Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Walnut Grove Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 670 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,365,000, townhomes $820,000, condos $588,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Walnut Grove Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Walnut Grove Secondary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 97.7% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 670 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Walnut Grove Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are James Kennedy Elementary (0.6 km east), Gordon Greenwood Elementary (0.9 km north-west) and West Langley Elementary (1.1 km north).

Walnut Grove Secondary is a secondary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 8919 Walnut Grove Dr. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: French Immersion (district find-a-school tag); Academies (district find-a-school tag).
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Walnut Grove Secondary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Walnut Grove Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Walnut Grove Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Walnut Grove Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 670 homes sold within 2 km of Walnut Grove Secondary: 177 houses, 262 townhomes and 216 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $820,000.
